description: This Java source file defines the 'UpdateThing' class, a command class used within the Eclipse Ditto framework to trigger a search index update for a specific 'Thing'. It includes fields, constructors, factory methods, and overrides related to command handling, JSON serialization, and object equality.

classes.name: UpdateThing
classes.description: A command class to request an update to the search index of a specific 'Thing' within the Eclipse Ditto platform. It encapsulates the necessary identifiers and provides JSON serialization, equality, and string representation functionalities.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of UpdateThing with specified ThingId and headers.

methods.description: Creates an UpdateThing command instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the command payload into a JSON object builder, including the 'thingId'.

methods.description: Returns the type prefix string for the command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the command category, which is MODIFY.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new UpdateThing instance with the specified DittoHeaders.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID associated with the command, which is the 'thingId'.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer for the resource path, which is empty for this command.

methods.description: Returns the resource type string associated with this command.
